question: Does the m103 alignment cost have a wider truth-ω tube than surrogate-MSE, enabling an outer ω-search the surrogate cannot?
hypothesis: Alignment cost could have a wider truth-ω tube and feed an outer ω-search around a surrogate q0-inner.
narrative_md: Same sweep shape as s003 but scoring the m103 alignment cost (peak-bisector dot vs allowed normals). The alignment cost is strictly worse than surrogate-MSE: only 5/72 cells keep argmin within 10° of truth (vs s003's 11/72), tubes are zero/near-zero in mag, seed 28's argmin is 176.8° from truth even at baseline truth-ω, and the cost is structurally undefined on 24/100 seeds (incl. seed 91). Alignment cost adds no ω-search value; joint (q0, ω) local descent remains the only viable architecture.
